steps.content: The coffin sits ahead, shrouded in desolate silence, still as stone, like nothing more than an ordinary vessel for the dead.
But you know what lies inside.
The chase ends here. The path meant to transcend life and death. The taboo that the living should never touch. And the one question only you can answer.
Your footsteps echo in lonely solitude. No enemies block your path, no companions offer comfort, and even the phantoms have faded into nothing. No one remains to guide you.
...But perhaps the "Lichen" within is still as gentle as when she bid you farewell? Perhaps you could still ask her for help?

As long as the power stops overflowing. As long as it stays away from the living Lichen. You want her to be safe, and you're willing to pay the price. The question now is: what must you offer for "her" to accept?
You take another step. It's right in front of you now.
The black coffin waits in absolute silence. Not a breath escapes. But you could swear you hear laughter, and your hand lifts toward it—
Clink—
You freeze. The rusted copper coin is still in your hand. You've been turning it over and over without realizing, as if seeking its guidance, as if replaying its warnings on an endless loop.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Offer no glance to the departed. Lend no ear to the abyss. Speak no question to the spirits...
<color=#dg1f1f>But it's rusted through, rotted away. It can no longer guide you. There's no point in relying on it anymore.</color>
The copper coin clatters to the ground. This time, you don't pick it up. You step over it and press on, until your hand finally rests upon the pitch-black coffin lid.

Incantations cover its surface, carved deep into the wood. Paper talismans layer over them. Red thread winds through the talismans, strung with thousands of cold copper coins. And binding it all together are iron chains as thick as a fist.
Layer upon layer, seal upon seal. Together with the heavy lid, they press down on whatever lies within—airtight, impenetrable, not a single crack left unsealed.
Your hands find the edge of the lid. You begin to push.

A child's palm is thinner than the coffin lid itself. You barely stand half its length. Even with your adult body, you doubt you could move it an inch. Pushing harder is futile. Perhaps you should stop and think of another way.
<color=#dg1f1f>No. You can do this. You just used this very body to evade the monster guarding the coffin.</color>
<color=#dg1f1f>Of course you can... Keep going.</color>

Something takes hold of you, an inexplicable confidence, a force not your own. Your arms grow warm as strength far beyond a child's capability floods through you. The copper coins on the coffin begin to tremble. They corrode before your eyes. Red threads snap. One by one, the seals fall away.
CRRRACK—!
You gather yourself and push. One final, forceful shove. The iron chains that bound the coffin snap apart, crashing down, then crumble to ash in an instant.

The black wood shifts, revealing a thin crack like a pitch-black eye slowly blinking awake. Your mind buzzes. Another scene overlays your vision. Distant sounds flood your ears. The world splits in two.
[Scene Change: Maria City]
...Little guide? Little guide?
Inform the medical department to bring Horo to the interrogation room...
steps.female_content: A strangely familiar voice reaches you, distant and near all at once. Your vision swims, but you can just make out a young man with disheveled, slightly curly hair. He half-kneels on the ground, cradling a child in his arms, gently patting the girl's face and calling out to her.

steps.content: ...Wait. That child... is you?
You passed out? Your consciousness entered the Void of Yin while your body remained behind? Then what... what is all this?
Your gaze drops. Through the haze, you see a blurry torso and blurry hands. Standing over a dozen meters from the unconscious "guide"... You are not the guide.
Then <color=#dg1f1f>who</color> are you right now?
It's no good; the kid won't wake. We've tried every path into the mapping layer. Your copper coin's shattered. If Lichen really is behind this...
□□, could you go talk to her? See if you can get through?
Hmm... Looks like there's no convincing her now.
—Shing.

The blade clears its sheath. Your attention snaps back to the scene before you: A figure stands between the two and <color=#dg1f1f>you</color>. <color=#dg1f1f>You</color> cannot see clearly, only the tip of a sword, leveled directly at <color=#dg1f1f>you</color>.
And from the pommel, a copper coin dangles.
<color=#dg1f1f>You</color> open your mouth to ask, but the voice that emerges is not yours. A familiar one.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Tossing coins like it's the holiday season? You think that will stop me?</color>

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Too late, old man.</color>

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>...That "child" will give me the answer soon enough.</color>
[Scene Transition: Back to the Coffin-Pushing Scene]
This question, too, never leaves your lips. Something tears you away. A violent force rips you from that body, hurling you back through the cold Void, back before the black coffin.
Your hands press against the lid, legs braced. Every muscle in your small body is fully committed to prying it open.

Your body does not listen. It moves anyway. When you heave with everything you have, fire streaks across your arms, and your little hands shove aside a coffin lid many times your own weight. It slides off completely, crashing to the ground.
THUD!
<color=#dg1f1f>...You did it. Well done.</color>

You have no voice, and no one answers. The fire burns on. Your vision warps; crimson patterns trace themselves across your skin like a silent, spreading stain. You grip the coffin and pull yourself in—
And you finally see her. A familiar face, peaceful beneath that mask. She slumbers as all the death-destined do: undisturbed, eternal, serene.
But the moment your eyes trace her features, the world lurches violently. A deafening cascade of fragmented whispers claw their way into your mind.
[White Flash]

steps.speaker: Fanatic Voice
steps.content: Master Lichen! I had the dream! I finally had the dream! A little immortal child came to me and said my mom's at peace in the world below, and we'll see each other again soon!

steps.speaker: Fanatic Voice
steps.content: You were right. Heaven doesn't want offerings, just faith! I came here day and night, burned 888 sticks of incense. I was always so scared my mom was being bullied down there, too scared to even eat. Now... now I can finally rest easy!

steps.speaker: Fanatic Voice
steps.content: Another one... Another one gets a vision in their dream. So there really are gods watching over us? Then why not me? Why won't she visit me? Or just... just let me go be with her!

steps.speaker: Fanatic Voice
steps.content: Hey, easy there, lad. Half the people here are in a worse spot than you. Knock over that incense, and you're not just dealing with me. You're dealing with everyone. And their fists.

steps.speaker: Fanatic Voice
steps.content: Look on the bright side, though! You came around, didn't you? You do it right, stay faithful, and getting a dream's just a matter of time!

steps.speaker: Fanatic Voice
steps.content: Me? I've never actually met her. But everyone who's gotten a reading from her swears she's the real deal. I know someone who lost everything—family, home, the whole lot. Then they had a dream. Gave 'em the will to go on. They've put their life back together. They're here every day now. I just tagged along one day and stayed.

steps.speaker: Fanatic Voice
steps.content: It's not like it costs you an arm and a leg, right? So why not try? These days, who doesn't have someone they're desperate to see again? And if it works? Jackpot.

Adrift in this boundless sea of fervent praise, a swirling white light coalesces before your eyes. It fills your vision, drowning out the world. You cradle your aching head, blinking again and again, desperately trying to make out something—

steps.speaker: Fanatic Voice
steps.content: Faith... brings answers... I'm faithful... I have to be faithful...

steps.speaker: Fanatic Voice
steps.content: Master, guide me... Please... Master, guide me...

Joy, longing, excitement—all the bright, hopeful things gather in these murmurs. They swell and intertwine, an emotional tide so potent it threatens to overflow, to crystallize into obsessive fanaticism. Then, you remember her words:

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I believe the Daoist arts make no distinction between righteous and wicked, good and evil. The Dao of Heaven is chaos; we'll never be able to fully grasp it. Arts that fulfill the wishes of the believers... those are good arts.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...And what <color=#fb9259>people believe in</color> will have power.
A sudden surge of fear jolts you half-awake.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You've been manipulating them... Cultivating their faith. You want to...

But there's no time to worry about others now. Crimson flames crawl up your limbs, binding you, commanding you. The fire's source burns deep in your chest, where her fingertips once pressed. The <color=#fb9259>protection talisman</color> is blazing.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: This... is no protection talisman...
Shared senses. Memory resonance. Guiding a child's body to defeat the coffin ghost... All of it is her Daoist arts, still working through you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You've been controlling me... Using me like a puppet, just like one of those phantoms...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Go now, young friend. I will be waiting for your answer.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You letting me come down here... It was your plan all along.
[Clatter]
The terminal slips from your grasp. It hits the ground, and in that instant, its white screen flickers. Against all odds, against all reason, it powers on.
[White Flash]

<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> I have arrived in Maria City. Where does the thread of fate lead next?

<color=#fb9259>Ziwei Diviner:</color> The hexagram is cast. Fortune favors your path. An <color=#fb9259>auspicious star</color> shall rise to meet you, one whose light pierces the Void of Yin.

<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> And where might this <color=#fb9259>auspicious star</color> now reside?

<color=#fb9259>Ziwei Diviner:</color> Westward lies the meeting.
[Page turn, add phone notification sound]
New messages pop up on the screen in rapid succession.

<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> This <color=#fb9259>auspicious star</color> you spoke of... his power runs deep, deeper than mortal hands should hold.
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> He has worn a mask since the moment we met, has he not?

<color=#fb9259>Ziwei Diviner:</color> No shadow darkens his intent. He blocks your way, yet holds no blade to your fate.

<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> Hehe... how gracefully you speak on his behalf.
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> Still, I've worn my own masks. This child... I find myself quite fond of his game.
steps.female_content:
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> This <color=#fb9259>auspicious star</color> you spoke of... her power runs deep, deeper than mortal hands should hold.
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> She has worn a mask since the moment we met, has she not?

<color=#fb9259>Ziwei Diviner:</color> No shadow darkens her intent. She blocks your way, yet holds no blade to your fate.

<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> Hehe... how gracefully you speak on her behalf.
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> Still, I've worn my own masks. This child... I find myself quite fond of her game.

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> Whether mortal or spirit, kin or stranger, whatever face lies beneath... In the end, he will lead me to what I seek. Is that true?
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> For he is, after all, my <color=#fb9259>auspicious star</color>.

<color=#fb9259>Ziwei Diviner:</color> ...
<color=#fb9259>Ziwei Diviner:</color> It is so.
steps.female_content:
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> Whether mortal or spirit, kin or stranger, whatever face lies beneath... In the end, she will lead me to what I seek. Is that true?
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> For she is, after all, my <color=#fb9259>auspicious star</color>.

<color=#fb9259>Ziwei Diviner:</color> ...
<color=#fb9259>Ziwei Diviner:</color> It is so.

steps.content: [White Flash + Return to the Inner World]
She knows. She has sensed what you hide, what you intend. Is that why she no longer holds back?
Your body betrays you. It bends forward, stiff and unwilling, moving toward the figure in the coffin. Against your will, your hands slide beneath her shoulder blades and waist, lifting her body up.

You know where "you" are taking her. You know, and the knowledge is a scream trapped in your throat. Resisting is like trying to hold back the tide; all you can force through clenched teeth is a handful of broken words.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...You can hear me, can't you, Lichen?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stop. Please... stop. That's not your shifu. Bringing her out serves you nothing.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No matter how you made your followers believe in <color=#fb9259>resurrection</color>... those who have crossed into the Void of Yin follow a different <color=#fb9259>Dao</color>. What you seek... you cannot have...

<color=#dg1f1f><size=60>Offer no glance to the departed.
Lend no ear to the abyss.
Speak no question to the spirits.</color></size>

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What you want is beyond your reach... Don't force this...

Your pleas fall empty into the coffin's depths. The rune burns against your chest as you continue cradling "Lichen's" body, inching it outward, millimeter by agonizing millimeter. As the figure in your arms emerges, the frozen air itself begins to stir.

A chill wind rises, drawing spectral flames toward the black coffin. The thick lid groans, cracks spider-webbing across its surface. An invisible seal is weakening, fast. Through your daze, you glimpse ruins on the other side.
The sealed rift has reappeared. And there, on the other side, stands Lichen, calm and still. A talisman pinched between her fingers.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Stop, Lichen. Stop.

Your body fights—every fiber screaming resistance—but all it can manage is a tremor. You watch, helpless, as Lichen on the other side draws another paper talisman to ignite it. Instantly, your body goes weightless, as if about to lift off, to slip from this space entirely.
Is this sorcery to pull you back? Or does she intend to use you—to drag "Lichen" with you to Maria City? If they actually meet, if they come face to face, they'll—
[Flashback: Corpse Hair-Brushing CG]

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...No. I can't let them meet.
There must be something beyond her control. Think.
There's still time. You have to stop this!
[Release the shackles]
Crimson light bursts. Shackles erupt from your body, piercing through you and "Lichen" at once. The illusions scatter, and with it, the world falls still.
Your feet hit the ground—heavy, real. Slowly, you reclaim your breath. Then your body heat. Then your sense of smell. The fire talisman on your chest has died; whatever held you has finally let go.
You loosen your arms from around "Lichen." The shackles settle. The light piercing her body softens, gentling until it matches the peaceful expression on her sleeping face.
Calm, serene, and yet... stubbornly unrepentant. You don't know what to feel.
The crimson glow of the shackles around your waists fades. Now you can see her clearly. Unlike the Lichen on the other side, this one bears far fewer scars.
You let out a sigh.
I understand what you wanted.
As for me... I'll explain everything when I return.
For now... let me say goodbye.

Perhaps you should reach out. Perhaps, one last time, you should touch her face. Perhaps, deep down, you secretly hope—the way the living always hope—that the dead could awaken and find some happy ending.
You never believed in resurrection. But how easily can anyone suppress that deeply human longing? That stubborn, foolish wish of the heart?
Then, you step back. Slowly.
<color=#dg1f1f>Your wish has been fulfilled.</color>
The Yin-Yang fish mask has opened. At some point, you don't know when. And "Lichen" opens her eyes.
They are wide, unblinking. They scan the sky of the Void, slow and deliberate. A smile forms at the corners of her lips. In that instant, fear seizes your heart.
—Those are not Lichen's eyes. Not the eyes of the dead. This person... she does not belong to this world.
Blue and crimson intertwine in her gaze. Divine and demonic. Yin and Yang. All separated by a single thought.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I see... So this is the truth you witnessed in the Void of Yin...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: My "shifu" was merely a phantom of my own longing. In both the Realm of Yang and the Void of Yin, all things are illusions born of the heart... Even I could not escape this.
She sits up, slowly turning her neck. Crack. Crack. Crack. Each one a distinct sound in the silence. Only then does she glance down at the shackles still faintly encircling her body.
Comprehension hits you instantly.
She used the very bond that held you together as her road here. It was, and always had been, her goal.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is no place for you. Go back, please, while you still can...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Any later... and you really won't have the chance...
She turns to face you, her gaze holding yours for a long, breathless moment. Finally, a smile crosses her lips, familiar yet horribly stiff.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: It is alright. Thank you for guiding me here, young friend... The divination was not wrong. You truly are my auspicious star.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Now then... will you enlighten me once more?
She draws closer, that faint smile still in place.
You have nowhere left to retreat.
Her fingers, cold as stone, press gently against the side of your neck. The touch is almost tender until it isn't. They tighten, grip firm, and begin to pull you toward her.
[CG]

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Since you have shattered the illusion I pursued... you shall answer my questions in her stead. First question...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: You, who wear that child's skin, standing before me yet not truly here... Who are you?
[Fade to Black]

steps.speaker: Shin?
steps.content: Yes... This city lives in all of you... And it is right here...

steps.speaker: Shin?
steps.content: You have but to do as she did... and chant its name...
